message: We propose a 7-year hybrid LTSA: $6.0M year-1 fee, 3% annual escalation, 96.5% availability guarantee with a 15% penalty cap, covering repairs and engines (rotables and lease engine excluded). This structure keeps your costs tied to actual running hours while giving you reliable availability support.
